title: Siege of the Sherpur Cantonment
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of the Sherpur Cantonment", at revision 1376920342, opens: "The siege of the Sherpur Cantonment was a battle fought in December 1879, during the Second Anglo-Afghan War. British forces were besieged by Afghan troops, then repulsed an assault." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q969018, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1879 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
